business_rules: Marker detection triggers a background task and broadcasts progress to admins via websocket.
Admin features like backfilling markers are guarded by admin checks in both frontend apps.
User subjective preferences for auto-skipping segments belong in general user preferences.
Direct Play first; HLS/transcode only when codec/container/audio incompatible.
Keep screen on while video is playing or locked; allow screen off when paused.
Stream URL TTL (expires_in) is calculated from media file duration, not fixed.
Scheduled tasks persist to SQLite tasks table. Intervals are configurable from admin UI.

patterns: Use ViewModel to bind Jetpack Compose state.
Grid layouts use GridCells.Adaptive(minSize=100.dp) with fillMaxWidth() + aspectRatio(). LazyRow items use fixed dp sizes with LocalConfiguration responsive breakpoints.
Phone vs tablet breakpoint: screenWidthDp < 600 = phone.
LucideIcons object is a thin alias layer over Material Icons Rounded — change icons by editing the alias, no caller changes needed.
VideoPlayer gesture hierarchy: root pointerInput for tap/drag when controls hidden, controls overlay handles its own events when visible.
In-app updates: Use Android DownloadManager + REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES + Intent.ACTION_VIEW for native APK install flow.
Scheduled tasks: Persist to SQLite 'tasks' table with configurable intervals. Repository pattern in backend/internal/repository/scheduled_task.go.
gotchas: Android app lacks websocket implementation; polling/fire-and-forget is required for background tasks for now.
Do NOT use dynamic relative width (fillMaxWidth or percentage) inside LazyRow — it hides the scroll affordance.
Nested Scaffolds cause double status bar padding — outer Scaffold needs contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0).
SliderDefaults.Track renders a stop indicator dot by default — pass drawStopIndicator = null to remove it.
Root pointerInput detectDragGestures intercepts Slider drag — skip gestures when controls are visible.
FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON must be tied to isPlaying (not just isLocked) to prevent screen timeout during playback.
Double subtitle rendering: Disable C.TRACK_TYPE_TEXT in ExoPlayer when DualSubtitleOverlay handles display.
AppVersionCard must use AuthManager's dynamic URL, NOT hardcoded BuildConfig.BASE_URL — causes connection failures on different networks.
GetLatest app version API must handle empty DB gracefully — return baseline version, not 404.
conventions: Use Netflix theme colors (NetflixRed, NetflixWhite, NetflixBlack, NetflixDark, NetflixGray, NetflixLightGray) across Android app UI.
Material Icons Rounded style for all icons via LucideIcons alias object.
Responsive sizing: phone (<600dp) gets smaller cards, fonts, poster widths; tablet keeps original sizes.
